comment: Moth Quantum bake manifest. Run: MOTH_API_KEY=... node scripts/moth-bake.mjs run. Job ids are recorded back after a successful run so re-bakes reuse the paid result. Engines that expose a mode parameter take it inside params; the top-level mode switch is only for QPU targeting. `generateValues` synthesizes a non-negative grid for blur-core-v1 without shipping it in this file.

jobs.consumer: long corridor reverb for tunnel/substation maps via SynthAudio.setReverbUrl

huge, diffuse reverb for the Void/neon maps; also a room-tone source. Audio-completion batch attempt (2026-09-18) was rejected at submission with a 422 ('params do not match the engine schema'): the plan's `stereo_width: 1.2` exceeds the engine maximum of 1.0, so no job was created and no credit was charged. Corrected to 1 here and baked in the follow-up run (2 cr, jobId recorded).

minimum pipeline proof (1 of 8 cr): tap map for the delay/feedback space; exercises the echo-map baker. First attempt (2026-09-18, job 99b64320-2524-4f17-8f69-8e2eeb43ef02) failed: 5x5=25 qubits exceeds the aer budget of 24 ('too_many_qubits', retryable:false), so no space was produced. Corrected to a 6x4=24 grid and resubmitted in the audio-completion batch (fresh 1 cr).

minimum pipeline proof (5 of 8 cr): ambient bed -> ambienceBus; exercises makeSourceAudio -> upload -> WAV -> the audio-clip baker -> the runtime bank. Verified shape: slot `result` is pcm16/22050/mono; duration = length*chunk_seconds - (length-1)*crossfade = 12 - 11*0.12 = 10.68 s, so the loop window is 0.5..10.5 s (11.5 s overran the clip).
